contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIA[E DD AVGG Q NN] ; D/ CONSTAN[S PF AVG]

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constans (AD343-348). Reverse: Two Victories facing each other, each holding a wreath. There is something in between the two Victories, corrosion obscures identification. Reverse inscription: VICTORIA[E DD AVGG Q NN]. Mint: Trier. Dimensions: diameter: 15.60mm; weight: 1.34g. Reference: Reece, R. and James, S. 2000. Identifying Roman Coins. Spink, London. P.…
